Lena (Marketing): Quick heads-up: scheduled blog + benchmark publish in ~40m. Need press routing and one-line exec quote. @Marco @Ravi please.
Marco (Comms): Will draft quote. Any embargo? Prefer short reporter list outreach first.
Lena (Marketing): No embargo. DM-first to 5 reporters, then social if no early blows.
Dana (Product): Added appendix with test configs. Note: no customer data used.
Ravi (Legal): Confirmed. Must include: 'No customer data was used.' Also use trademarked product name: 'Redwood Optimize'.
Marco (Comms): Exec quote: "Redwood Optimize helps teams reduce inference cost while preserving UX." Ok?
Lena (Marketing): Good. Short and safe. I'll upload the press kit shortly.
press-monitor-bot: Monitor live. Will post pickups >2k reach.
Sam (Support): Standby in #optimize-press-triage. Added quick FAQ + escalation steps.
Marco (Comms): Outreach sent to 3/5 reporters. Waiting on replies; will update here. Holding social until green.
